points: GitHub Changelog confirms up to 10 callback URIs, wildcard matching, eight-hour access tokens, six-month refresh tokens, and rollout options.
G2 read both pages: official GitHub changelog/docs, community discussion, daily.dev, videos, Stack Overflow, Auth.js, Logto, and multiple current guides fill both pages.

G3 veto: GitHub Docs fully documents expiring tokens, refresh-token exchange, redirect URLs and flows; Auth.js provides a free end-to-end GitHub OAuth implementation guide. Both are stable, indexable, exact-task pages.
